assertions.name: RemoteRuntimeRequestConnection reuses one encrypted WebSocket for multiple one-shot RPCs
RemoteRuntimeRequestConnection aborts one request without closing the cached connection

infrastructureTests.scope: Fixture regressions; not original-source or product cases

limits: One encrypted socket reused for two requests with capability payload and response checks; one request aborted while same connection remains usable. This does not prove remote work cancellation, general reconnect, SSH/Tailscale, native Electron, real runtime dispatch, independent cryptographic security, migrated behavior or product parity.
sourceConfigDifferences: Original installed Vitest4.1.11 and Node24.19.0. Minimal node config omits aliases, DOM/canvas/host-port setup, feature-wall define, GC/WebStorage flags and extended timeouts. This whole suite explicitly binds ephemeral loopback ports, uses no GC/DOM hooks and restores mocks; it does not require that setup for these two assertions.

Transport package trees are pinned. Optional ws native peers are disabled per child via WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL=1 and WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE=1; real ws/tweetnacl/zod implementations remain. Native-addon/performance, full config and real SSH equivalence are not established.
